items.title: Theme-change system logs are plain in the default chat theme
items.precondition: Sign in with a conversation containing at least one prior theme-change entry, or create one by selecting a chat theme.
steps: Open /messages/:conversationId with the default chat theme.
Inspect every theme-change entry in the message timeline, including an entry created during this check.
Confirm each entry is centered muted text without a rounded outline, fill, chip padding, or bubble-like background.
Confirm its date/timestamp label, when present, is plain centered text with no rounded outline, border, or filled background.
items.expected: Theme-change system logs and their date/timestamp labels are plain centered text with no pill treatment.

items.title: Plain system logs remain readable in custom chat themes
items.precondition: A conversation is available and can use solid and gradient custom chat themes.
steps: Apply one available solid custom chat theme and inspect a theme-change log at desktop and narrow/mobile widths.
Apply one available gradient custom chat theme and repeat the inspection.
Confirm both logs and their date/timestamp labels use readable muted text only, with no fill, border, or rounded pill shape.
Confirm changing the theme creates the expected new system-log entry exactly once.
items.expected: System-log text remains legible in solid and gradient themes without restoring a shaded chip; theme changes still append exactly one chronological log entry.

items.title: Pin activity remains the unchanged visual reference
items.precondition: A conversation permits pinning a message.
steps: Pin a message and then unpin it.
Confirm the pin and unpin activity rows stay as plain centered text.
Compare them with a theme-change system log in the same thread.
Confirm normal messages and message ordering are unchanged, while the date/timestamp label is plain text.
items.expected: Theme-change, pin/unpin, and date/timestamp labels share a plain-text visual language; only their content differs.

items.title: Frontend verification gate
items.expected: All commands exit successfully with no errors caused by the system-log presentation change.
items.evidence: 2026-08-21: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck, lint, and build all exited successfully after the initial plain-log change and again after the date/timestamp pill removal.
items.notes: Lint emitted six pre-existing warnings in PostDetailPage, MessageQuoteStrip, PostPhotoCommentsPage, AuthContext, and ThemeContext. Vite emitted its existing large-chunk advisory.
